# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.26

A big consolidated release: broader wrapper-free format support, a synced-lyrics regression fixed, several reliability and crash fixes, and a batch of security hardening.

### What's new

- **Most audio formats no longer need the wrapper.** With GAMDL 3.8 support, AAC, Dolby Atmos, Dolby Digital, and their variants can now download without the wrapper tool — only Lossless (ALAC) still requires it.

### What's fixed

- **Word-by-word synced lyrics work again.** They had been silently falling back to plain line-by-line timing; the word-level detail is restored.
- **Animated cover art downloads more reliably.**
- **Exporting a diagnostic report no longer crashes** when your download history contains certain international characters.
- **Restoring a backup of your settings is safer.** A security fix closes a path where a specially crafted backup file could write files outside your chosen folder.
- **A one-time "after queue" action (like playing a sound or opening a folder) no longer repeats itself** on a later download when you'd only asked for it once.
- **Smaller fixes**: screen readers now correctly announce the Cancel and Retry buttons on queue items, harmless technical warnings no longer clutter the Activity Log during downloads, and sensitive wrapper connection details are better protected in diagnostic exports.

### Notes

- **GAMDL 2.x is no longer supported.** MeedyaDL now requires GAMDL 3.0 or newer — if you're still on an old GAMDL 2.x install, update it or Apple Music downloads will stop working.
- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
